description: Realistic prompts with every expected rule detection, in order. Values are specification examples and published test values only: RFC 2606 example domains, NANP 555-01xx fictional numbers, Ofcom drama numbers (020 7946 0xxx), libphonenumber's example numbers, Stripe test cards, SWIFT IBAN registry examples, AWS and Google documentation example keys. Secret tokens are written as {{NAME}} and built at test time so the repository holds no scanner-matching literals.
